ideas.pitch: An offline edge-AI system running on low-power NPUs to detect critical satellite telemetry anomalies in real-time without ground station delay.
ideas.problem_statement: Software Track: Space/Astronomy Data Processing and Anomaly Detection
ideas.title: AstroTrack NPU: On-Board Satellite Telemetry & Anomaly Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the offline AI processing pattern from winning projects like DevMesh, directly addressing the core aerospace challenge of autonomous orbital monitoring.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous surface rover capable of navigating simulated obstacles and transmitting telemetry over a redundant low-bandwidth mesh network.
ideas.problem_statement: Hardware Track: Robotics and Autonomous Aerospace Systems
ideas.title: Mars Rover Mesh: Autonomous Rover Tele-operation over Acoustic/RF Relay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines the physical build and robotics patterns of Quanta 2025 winner Rover with robust off-grid networking, highly impressive for judges evaluating hardware.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance computational tool that ingests TLE orbital data, simulates conjunction risks, and generates optimal orbital dodge burns.
ideas.problem_statement: Software Track: Space Situational Awareness and Traffic Management
ideas.title: Orbital Debris Collision Avoidance & Trajectory Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a high-stakes, mathematically rigorous problem with a working visual dashboard, standing out from standard CRUD apps.

ideas.pitch: A custom FPGA-based hardware module that reads high-frequency aerodynamic pressure sensor arrays and instantly computes lift-to-drag coefficients.
ideas.problem_statement: Hardware Track: Aeronautics and Wind Tunnel Instrumentation
ideas.title: AeroFoil FPGA: Real-Time Wind Tunnel Pressure Sensor Processing Unit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Hits the 'genuinely hard engineering' and custom hardware patterns seen in SanDisk Hardware Hackathon winning projects.

ideas.pitch: An onboard optical navigation system that uses star trackers and horizon line-of-sight algorithms to compute accurate drone coordinates without GPS.
ideas.problem_statement: Software Track: Autonomous Guidance and Navigation
ideas.title: StarNav: GPS-Denied Celestial Navigation Assistant for UAVs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies computer vision and astronomy to a critical defense and aerospace use case, demonstrating advanced technical depth within a 12-hour build window.
